summary: This RCA task investigated a stalled task's 'periodic checkpoint' watchdog signature and honestly root-caused it to host-wide OOM contention from an unbounded veridian-worker@.service, not a code defect; it verified (via systemctl show and journalctl) that a concurrent sibling RCA task had already applied the real, shared fix (MemoryHigh/MemoryMax/MemorySwapMax on the non-repo-tracked systemd unit template) and correctly avoided duplicating that edit, then registered the required known_fixes evidence per the task's success criteria. Git state confirms zero commits ahead of master and a clean working tree, so this is a genuine no-op with respect to this repo -- there is no code diff to audit for correctness or security, and nothing unsafe would be merged.
